    Estimates time, filament and cost.
    Runnable with Python 3, standard library only.
"""
PRINTER = "Hobby 3D Printer (220 mm cube) - Full Blueprint"

def estimate(model_cm3, layer_h=0.2, speed_mms=60, infill=0.2, filament_dia=1.75,
             filament_price_kg=25.0, power_w=350.0, elec_price_kwh=0.15):

    import math
    # filament cross-section from diameter
